adds.title: Hawkeye#1
adds.text: Clint takes Cooper and his siblings to New York for Christmas. They walk out of the musical together and spend the evening at dinner and the Rockefeller Center tree.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Clint's eldest son, on a Christmas trip with him to New York.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Cooper's dad, who takes the kids to New York for Christmas.
adds.evidence: Never Meet Your Heroes (Hawkeye ep 1): Clint, Cooper, Lila and Nathaniel attend Rogers: The Musical, leave midway, eat at a Chinese restaurant (Cooper picks ugly sweaters as his activity, thanks the waiter) and see the tree. Ep 2: Clint leaves Cooper in charge as the kids fly home; ep 6: Cooper greets him and helps carry in presents.

adds.title: Hawkeye#4
adds.text: Laura helps Clint from home while he stays in New York, tracking the signal of her old S.H.I.E.L.D. watch and sending him the address where it is hidden.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Clint's wife, who tracks her stolen watch for him from home.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Laura's husband, who stays in New York to get her old watch back.
adds.evidence: Partners, Am I Right? (ep 4): with Laura's help Clint recovers his sword, and Laura tells him the stolen watch is sending a tracking signal from an apartment building (3715 Godrey Road). Earlier calls in ep 1 and 2; ep 5 she tells him to end it; ep 6 he returns the watch to her on Christmas.

adds.title: Hawkeye#1
adds.text: On a Christmas trip to New York, Lila finds Clint outside the musical and hugs him, knowing it reminds him of Natasha. The family skips the rest of it together.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Clint's daughter, who sees how much he misses Natasha.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Lila's dad, who struggles through a musical about the Avengers.
adds.evidence: Never Meet Your Heroes (ep 1): Lila leaves the theater to find Clint, tells him it's fine not to watch since Natasha was his best friend, and hugs him. Ep 2: he promises her he'll be home for Christmas and tells her she is really in charge; ep 6: 'You made it. You kept your promise.'

adds.title: Hawkeye#1
adds.text: Clint takes Nathaniel and his siblings to New York for Christmas. Nathaniel gives away to his mother that they left the musical early, and Clint carries him back to the hotel asleep.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Clint's youngest son, on a Christmas trip with him to New York.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Nathaniel's dad, who takes the kids to New York for Christmas.
adds.evidence: Never Meet Your Heroes (ep 1): at dinner Clint tries to tell Laura the play was good but Nathaniel tells her they left halfway; Clint carries him into the hotel. Ep 2: Nathaniel signs 'I love you' to him; ep 3: Nathaniel calls him on Laura's phone.

adds.title: Hawkeye#2
adds.text: Laura picks Cooper and his siblings up from the airport and makes gingerbread houses with them while Clint is held up in New York.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Cooper's mom, who brings the kids home while Dad stays in New York.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Laura's son, home with her for Christmas while his dad is away.
adds.evidence: Hide and Seek (ep 2): the kids fly home, Laura picks them up and they build gingerbread houses while she takes Clint's call. Ep 1 she calls the family at dinner; ep 4 she tells the kids Dad will be away longer; ep 6 Christmas together.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Lila accuses Cooper of taking her headphones, a squabble Clint overhears when a time travel test drops him back in the family farmhouse. Both vanish in the Snap and return after the Blip.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Cooper's sister, who accuses him of losing her headphones.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Lila's brother, who swears he never had her headphones.
adds.evidence: Avengers: Endgame, Clint's quantum test trip to the old farmhouse: Lila: 'Cooper! Where. Are. My. Headphones?' Cooper: 'I never had them.' Cast list credits 'Cooper Barton / Time Heist Test (voice)' and 'Lila Barton / Time Heist Test'.

adds.title: Hawkeye#1
adds.text: Cooper and Lila share a Christmas trip to New York with their dad and brother, and watch the news of Ronin's return together in their hotel room.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Cooper's sister, on the family trip to New York.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Lila's brother, on the family trip to New York.
adds.evidence: Never Meet Your Heroes (ep 1): after the tree, Cooper and Lila watch the NY1 report on Ronin's reappearance in the hotel room. Ep 2: Clint puts Cooper in charge, then tells Lila she really is.

adds.title: Hawkeye#1
adds.text: On their family's Christmas trip to New York, Cooper and Nathaniel slip out of the musical together to join their dad and sister outside.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Cooper's little brother, on the family trip to New York.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Nathaniel's big brother, on the family trip to New York.
adds.evidence: Never Meet Your Heroes (ep 1): Cooper and Nathaniel leave the show and meet Clint and Lila outside; at dinner Cooper refuses to clean up if Nathaniel eats too much crab.

adds.title: Hawkeye#2
adds.text: Laura picks Lila and her brothers up from the airport and makes gingerbread houses with them while Clint is held up in New York.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Laura's daughter, home with her for Christmas while Dad is away.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Lila's mother, who brings the kids home while Dad stays in New York.
adds.evidence: Hide and Seek (ep 2): Laura picks the kids up and they make gingerbread houses. Ep 4: Lila is irritated when Laura speaks German on the phone so the kids won't understand.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: At a farm picnic Laura praises Nathaniel's throwing and lets him have ketchup on his hot dog. Moments later they vanish in the Snap, and they return together after the Blip.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Laura's youngest son, who wants ketchup at the picnic.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Nathaniel's mother, who vanishes with him in the Snap and returns.
adds.evidence: Avengers: Endgame opening picnic: Laura: 'Nate, mayo or mustard?' Nathaniel: 'How 'bout ketchup?' Laura and Cooper praise his throwing; both are dusted, then restored in the Blip.

adds.title: Hawkeye#1
adds.text: Laura calls the family at dinner in New York, and Nathaniel tells her they walked out of the musical halfway through.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Laura's youngest son, who tells her the truth about the musical.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Nathaniel's mother, who calls the family in New York.
adds.evidence: Never Meet Your Heroes (ep 1): Laura calls to ask about the show; Nathaniel interrupts Clint to tell her they left halfway. Ep 2 gingerbread houses together; ep 5 she puts him to bed.

adds.title: Hawkeye#1
adds.text: Lila and Nathaniel share a Christmas trip to New York with their dad and brother. At dinner she warns he will be sick if he eats any more crab.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Lila's little brother, on the family trip to New York.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Nathaniel's older sister, on the family trip to New York.
adds.evidence: Never Meet Your Heroes (ep 1): Nathaniel wants three more crabs and Lila warns he'll vomit. Ep 2: gingerbread houses together at home.

adds.title: The Marvels
adds.text: Aamir fights off the Kree who wreck the Khan home and is left with broken glasses and questions for his sister. When Kamala leaves on her mission, he tells her to come back safely.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Aamir's sister, whose fight wrecks the family home.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Kamala's brother, who asks her to come home safe.
adds.evidence: The Marvels: Aamir hits a Kree soldier with a coat rack and gets his glasses broken, looks at Kamala in disappointment, asks Monica 'Where's my sister?', and says 'You better. I don't wanna be an only child' as she leaves; he hugs her when she returns.

adds.title: The Marvels
adds.text: Aamir leaps to help when a Kree soldier attacks Muneeba in their home. Later, when she hints that the Rambeau house would suit a family, he mutes her with a remote.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Aamir's mother, who hints it's time he raised a family.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Muneeba's son, who jumps in when the Kree attack her.
adds.evidence: The Marvels: 'As Aamir saw a guard attack his mother, he leaped over the couch to help'; at the Rambeau Residence Muneeba says 'Aamir... this would be a lovely house to raise a family in', and he jokingly mutes her with a remote.

owner_calls.title: Avengers: Endgame
owner_calls.question: These two family pairs are at the same farm picnic and vanish in the same Snap and return in the same Blip, but never speak to or deal with each other directly. The existing Laura and Lila Endgame stage is 'vanish together in the Snap'. Add a matching stage for these pairs?
options: No stage (they share the picnic but never deal with each other)
Add a 'vanish together in the Snap at the family picnic and return after the Blip' stage for consistency with Laura and Lila
owner_calls.evidence: Endgame picnic: Laura cooks and asks Clint, Lila and Nathaniel about condiments; Cooper plays catch with Nathaniel; Lila does archery with Clint. Everyone but Clint is dusted.
